scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,worker,frontend" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start:prod: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start
scripts.start:worker: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run worker:email
